scientific_integrity: Exact orthogonal-projection and rational-difference argument, supplemented by a reproducible SymPy checker; finite checks are not used as a proof of the infinite parameter theorem.
scientific_limitations: Standard radial power-weight Bergman Hilbert spaces only; anti-analytic quadratic conjugate symbol only; no higher monomial powers or general weights; exact all-alpha proof is presented, but worldwide novelty has not been independently established and a pertinent 1988 paper could not be compared in full.
title: An infinite weight staircase for optimal quadratic-conjugate approximation in Bergman spaces
